original_source_doubts.adjudication: Double decoration on first completed A in tensor product is visible but scan is degraded; retained double bar is not independently resolved. Do not silently simplify to one completion.
French itself prints xi in F_{S prime} immediately after alpha; type should be F_S. Preserve with an explicit source note, unlike nearby lowercase s which is a transcription error.
French itself calls T^I covariant in I although the evident construction is contravariant. Retain historical wording; distinguish from genuine simplicial terminology mistranslation.
French calls nonabelian cocycles a sous-groupe; generally only a subset. Retain source wording with source-doubt note, not an unmarked correction.
Strict S-descent appears in French and English; likely script F was intended. Retain/annotate rather than silently normalize.

Original says A definition1.(d) and definition1d for exactness/subsheaves; the current hyperlinks point Definition1.1. French reference is itself defective: no definition1d of that sort. Restore printed original reference plus an explicit note giving likely Definition1.2 and descent data, not a false confident hyperlink.
Original says x,y sections of A prime even though the pairing uses F1 prime,F2 prime. Keep as original doubt; cannot silently repair to module sections.
French prints x_i^p=0; visually confirmed. This strong special-case p-basis relation is not a Chinese transcription error.
Both source and translation allow arbitrary marked sections in uniqueness statement; invertibility/nonvanishing is seemingly required. Original statement retained, no invented condition.
Tensor base and sheaf placements in Omega formula appear as printed source; do not normalize to modern pullback notation without a source note.

Y-prime for rational-function ring and Y for rational-function field are visibly printed glyphs in French, inconsistent with subsequent K,K-prime. Classify as original inconsistent notation, not proven English corruption. Preserve with explicit note; no proposed automatic Y->K replacement.

French literally SERRE [1] in terminology paragraph; [1] is Dieudonne-Grothendieck EGA, while likely intended Serre [6]. English GD1960 preserves the wrong original number but hides the mismatch. Render Serre [原编号1；疑应为6] with original bibliography rather than silently relink.
French itself prints h_X(Y)->h_X(Y prime) corresponding to Y->Y prime; contravariance would reverse it. Retain with original-source note.
Prime marks on h and X_j, L versus script L, and F versus overline F in limit identity are inconsistent already in French. Do not globally regularize notation unannounced.

French visibly prints F(xi)^(-1)(xi), not F(epsilon)^(-1)(xi); retain with explicit original typo note. Likewise quotient denominator m^2+nO is printed without grouping; parenthesization is editorial clarification, not a missing proof.
Y in place of S (y in Y, Artin Y-algebras, topological Y-algebra, closed points of Y) is visible in French; annotate original inconsistency rather than blindly replace.
French visibly prints H^1; expected tangent to Hom is H^0. Confirmed original error retained; not a translation correction.
French appears to change sheaf G to F in coherence hypotheses, while F already denotes a functor. Original ambiguity retained; requires source annotation, not a silent G substitution.
French calls Picard functor covariant in T, contrary to displayed Hom functor; French also uses Y in remark for base S. Preserve and label original errors.

French original proper with separable fibres plus C-05 add proper et separable explains redundant Chinese proper,separable,and separable fibres. No removal needed; mark explicit author supplement if desired.
Original prints I_A=At/(t^2), likely missing brackets; retained as original typography. Prefer a visible source note referring to earlier A[t]/(t^2), not silent rewrite.

C-05 corrects stalk equality to inclusion and adds hat on O_0 prime. Chinese has both corrections. Explanation after inclusion describes completed local extensions; avoid claiming that every completed extension belongs to the stalk.
